Samir P.: Drafting a statuspage notice for GEN-503 (initial). Please quick review, aim to publish in ~2m.
Samir P.: STATUSPAGE DRAFT:
```
Incident: Partial degradation of generation service (gen-service)
Scope: Some Hosted API customers in US-West regions using streaming / large-context generation
Impact: Increased latency (200–600ms) and intermittent 5xx (~2–4%) for affected requests
Mitigation: Traffic reroute to EU fallback (partial), KV cache warmup, scaling in progress
ETA: 45–90 minutes (working estimate). We'll post hourly updates or sooner.
```
Lina W.: LGTM for tone. Change 'Customers' -> 'some customers' and say 'canary rollback in progress' instead of 'queued'.
Priya (legal): Quick legal sanity check — no PII, ok. Add sentence: 'We will provide follow-ups and a post-incident report as available.'
Alex T.: Ops: already routing ~30% to EU fallback, autoscaler added 2 nodes. Suggest update: 'mitigation in progress; reduced error rate expected within 30–60m.'
Maria K.: l10n: avoid idioms, I'll prep FR/DE/JP translations in #ops-localization and flag anything sensitive.
Samir P.: Updated draft below — ready for final checks. @incident-bot please mark draft-ready.

Incident update (INITIAL):
```
We are investigating reports of increased generation latency and intermittent errors impacting some customers in the US‑West region. Our engineers have routed a portion of traffic to a EU fallback and are scaling backend capacity. Mitigation is in progress; we expect service stabilization within 45–90 minutes. We will provide hourly updates and a post‑incident report once available.
```
incident-bot: draft-ready — runbook /runbooks/GEN-503 attached. Tags: p1, routing, statuspage.
Lina W.: Minor edit: replace 'some customers' -> 'some Hosted API customers in US‑West' and add 'no data loss' sentence.
Samir P.: Final draft updated and queued. Scheduling publish in 2 minutes. /status publish --scope=initial
Alex T.: Publishing now. :rocket:
incident-bot: Published to https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/GEN-503 at 1711122340
Samir P.: Hourly update #1: mitigation progressing — 60% traffic routed to fallback, error rate down ~30%. Continuing scaling & cache warmup. Next update in 1h or earlier if changes.
Priya (legal): Thanks, wording is fine.
Maria K.: Translations posted to #ops-localization (FR/DE complete, JP in progress).
Lina W.: :+1:
Alex T.: Ops note: we'll attempt canary rollback if error spike >5% again. Keeping monitor on.
Samir P.: RESOLVED DRAFT:
```
Status: Resolved — service restored for affected requests in US‑West.
Summary: Scaling and traffic reroute mitigations restored normal traffic patterns. Error rates and latency returned to baseline.
Customer impact: Some Hosted API customers in US‑West experienced elevated latency and intermittent errors for ~1 hour. No data loss.
Next steps: Post-incident report (RCA) will be published to the runbook within 48 hours. Follow-ups: capacity tuning + improved routing automation.
```
incident-bot: Marking incident resolved at 1711122880 and posting resolved notice.
Samir P.: Thanks team — closing thread. Please add any follow-up tasks to the RCA doc.
